response.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type='VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id=t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS mean_signed FROM f) SELECT AVG(f.avg_signed) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(f.avg_bal) AS avg_balance, AVG(f.avg_signed - m.mean_signed) AS avg_excess FROM f CROSS JOIN m WHERE f.avg_signed > m.mean_signed

assumptions.assumption: Per-frequency average signed amount ignores (NULL) transactions of types other than PRIJEM/VYDAJ, so VYBER rows are excluded from the signed average (AVG skips NULLs), but their balances are still included in the average balance since that is over all the account's transactions.
The 'plain mean' is the unweighted mean of the per-frequency averages (one value per frequency), not weighted by transaction count.
